Beta release with cross-platform CLI compatibility checks, GitHub Releases distribution decision, single active installed config, RTK enforce preservation, and refreshed package/release-readiness validation.

Download the archive for your OS/CPU, extract it, and run the included sane-next command from the extracted directory. The archives include the CLI plus the overlay assets it installs.

Verified locally:
- bash .githooks/pre-commit
- cd cli && go test ./...
- node --test pi-plugin/plugin.test.js
- cd cli && ./acceptance.sh
- release archive install/doctor smoke test
- cross-build Linux/macOS/Windows amd64+arm64
